premises.text: Existing tools are optimized for product delivery rather than product discovery
premises.evidence_span: stuck with tools that are optimized and designed for product delivery, not the crucial part of product discovery

premises.text: Customer feedback is hoarded across scattered systems, records, and formats
premises.evidence_span: We hoard feedback in a variety of systems, records, and formats

premises.text: A system of record can aggregate feedback, link insights to features by user need, prioritize against goals, and automate interactive roadmaps through to engineering tools
premises.evidence_span: system of record for product management that helps product people understand what people need, prioritize what to build, and automate interactive roadmaps

premises.text: The product is sold as a per-user tiered subscription
premises.evidence_span: subscription service with a per user tiered pricing starting at $24 a month

premises.text: Customers are reached through content marketing and inside sales for cross-sell and up-sell
premises.evidence_span: reach our customers via combination of content marketing and inside sales for cross-sell and up-sell
